experiments.question: Can booking-api@v1's schema state simple-login.backend's amend (a title holding U+0000 or an unpaired surrogate is refused) under the backend replay rig's strict Ajv settings, keep all 35 fixtures valid, and give the same verdict whether or not a validator compiles the pattern with the unicode flag?
experiments.finding: Yes. The whole-string pattern ^(?:[^\u0000\uD800-\uDFFF]|[\uD800-\uDBFF][\uDC00-\uDFFF])*$, in an allOf beside the unchanged \S pattern, compiles under Ajv2020 { strict, allErrors } + ajv-formats; all 35 fixtures still validate; 17 named titles behave as expected (80 emoji accepted, U+0000, lone lead, lone trail and a reversed pair refused); over 200,000 random strings the pattern with and without the u flag never disagrees with isWellFormed() plus a U+0000 check. S05's booking-api-fixtures/check.mjs also still passes against the amended schema.
